title: Jigsaw Structure
description: Defines a jigsaw structure that generates in the world using template pools and structure sets.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this jigsaw structure definition.

minecraft:jigsaw.title: Jigsaw Definition
minecraft:jigsaw.description:
The jigsaw structure definition.

Properties:
• description (object)
• biome_filters
• step (string)
• terrain_adaptation (string)
• start_pool (string)
• max_depth (int) = 7
• max_distance_from_center ({ horizontal, vertical })
• start_height ({ type, value })
• ... and 1 more properties

description.title: Description
description.description:
The description block containing the structure identifier.

Properties:
• identifier (string)

biome_filters.title: Biome Filters
biome_filters.description: Array of filter conditions that determine which biomes can generate this structure.

step.title: Generation Step
step.description: The world generation step during which this structure generates. Valid values: 'raw_generation', 'lakes', 'local_modifications', 'underground_structures', 'surface_structures', 'strongholds', 'underground_ores', 'underground_decoration', 'fluid_springs', 'vegetal_decoration', 'top_layer_modification'.

terrain_adaptation.title: Terrain Adaptation
terrain_adaptation.description: How the structure adapts to terrain. Valid values: 'none', 'beard_thin', 'beard_box', 'bury', 'encapsulate'.

start_pool.title: Start Pool
start_pool.description: The identifier of the template pool to use as the starting point for structure generation.

max_depth.title: Maximum Depth
max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for jigsaw piece connections. Higher values allow more complex structures.

max_distance_from_center.title: Maximum Distance From Center
max_distance_from_center.description:
Maximum horizontal and vertical distance pieces can generate from the structure center.

Properties:
• horizontal (int) = 80
• vertical (int) = 80

defaultSnippets.label: Maximum Distance From Center
defaultSnippets.description: Maximum horizontal and vertical distance pieces can generate from the structure center.

start_height.title: Start Height
start_height.description:
The height at which the structure starts generating.

Properties:
• type (string)
• value ({ absolute, above_bottom, below_top })

value.title: Value
value.description:
The height value or configuration.

Properties:
• absolute (int)
• above_bottom (int)
• below_top (int)

defaultSnippets.label: Start Height
defaultSnippets.description: The height at which the structure starts generating.

heightmap_projection.title: Heightmap Projection
heightmap_projection.description: Which heightmap to use for surface placement. Valid values: 'world_surface', 'world_surface_wg', 'ocean_floor', 'ocean_floor_wg', 'motion_blocking', 'motion_blocking_no_leaves'.
